_meta.description: Document-rules config for ibc_application — Application before NCLT under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 — Section 7 (financial creditor), Section 9 (operational creditor), or Section 10 (corporate applicant) for initiation of CIRP. Minimum default threshold ₹1 crore.
_meta.change_protocol: All edits require CLO sign-off. Innoventive, Mobilox, Swiss Ribbons cites mandatory. Form 1/2/3/4/5 per CIRP Regulations.

title: Application under Section 7 / 9 / 10 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 for initiation of CIRP

partyDesignations.label: Applicant (Financial Creditor / Operational Creditor / Corporate Applicant)

fields.label: Section invoked
Applicant name (creditor / corporate debtor itself for S.10)
Applicant type
Applicant registered address
Authorised representative + board resolution / power of attorney details
Corporate Debtor name
Corporate Debtor CIN
Corporate Debtor registered office address
Corporate Debtor paid-up capital (₹)
NCLT bench (per location of registered office)
Total amount in default (₹) — must be ≥ ₹1 crore
Nature of debt (financial / operational + brief description)
Documents proving debt (loan agreement / invoices / agreements / acknowledgments)
Date of default
Proof of default (records from information utility / books of account / bank statements)
S.8 demand notice date (mandatory for S.9 OC application)
Proof of delivery of S.8 demand notice
Reply received to S.8 notice
Any pre-existing dispute disclosed by CD (S.9 — Mobilox test) — details
Proposed Interim Resolution Professional (IRP) — name, IBBI registration
Written consent of IRP in Form 2 obtained
Limitation position — date of default + 3-year limitation; any acknowledgments u/s.18 LImitation Act
Advocate name
Bar Council enrollment number

verificationTemplate:
VERIFICATION

I, {applicant_authorised_rep_name}, the authorised representative of the Applicant herein duly authorised vide {authorisation_reference}, do hereby verify under solemn affirmation that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {lastParagraph} of the above application are true and correct to my personal knowledge derived from the records of the Applicant. No part is false and nothing material has been concealed.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

Authorised Representative

promptInstructions: Draft an application under Section 7 / 9 / 10 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 before NCLT for initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP).
JURISDICTION: NCLT bench with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office of the Corporate Debtor (per S.60(1) IBC).
FORM: Strict adherence to forms prescribed under the IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016:
- S.7 Financial Creditor: Form 1 (CIRP Regulation 2 read with Rule 4 IBC AAA Rules 2016)
- S.9 Operational Creditor: Form 5 + S.8 Demand Notice in Form 3 or 4
- S.10 Corporate Applicant: Form 6
MINIMUM THRESHOLD: ₹1 crore default (raised from ₹1 lakh by MCA Notification S.O. 1205(E) dated 24-Mar-2020 under S.4 IBC).
Para 1: Parties — Applicant + Corporate Debtor.
Para 2: NCLT bench jurisdiction.
Para 3: Applicant status:

- S.7 Financial Creditor: 'financial debt' definition S.5(8) — disbursal for time value of money; loans, debentures, real estate allottees (Pioneer Urban Land), security deposits where commercial effect of borrowing.
- S.9 Operational Creditor: 'operational debt' S.5(21) — claim in respect of provision of goods or services including employment, or debt to government for taxes.
- S.10 Corporate Applicant: corporate debtor itself; must produce special resolution + financial statements.

Para 4: Debt particulars — amount in default; documentary basis; books of account; information utility (IU) records — NeSL records preferred (S.7(3)(a)(ii)). For S.9, invoices + demand notice + reply (if any).

Para 5: Default — date + evidence. For S.7 / S.9, default is non-payment of debt that has become due and payable, and not paid. For S.10, financial information disclosing default + special resolution authorising CIRP filing.
Para 6: Threshold compliance — confirm ≥ ₹1 crore.

Para 7 (S.9 ONLY): S.8 Demand Notice — mandatory precondition. Form 3 (general demand) or Form 4 (invoice-based demand) — delivered by registered post / hand delivery + 10-day waiting period before filing.

Para 8 (S.9 ONLY): No pre-existing dispute — Cite Mobilox Innovations Pvt Ltd v. Kirusa Software Pvt Ltd (2018) 1 SCC 353 — pre-existing dispute test: (i) dispute must be raised BEFORE receipt of demand notice, (ii) must not be a moonshine / hypothetical / illusory dispute, (iii) court only checks plausibility of dispute, not its merits.

Para 9: Limitation — Cite B.K. Educational Services v. Parag Gupta (2019) 11 SCC 633: Article 137 Limitation Act applies — 3 years from default. Acknowledgments under S.18 Limitation Act extend (Asset Reconstruction Co v. Bishal Jaiswal (2021) 6 SCC 366).
Para 10: Cite Innoventive Industries Ltd v. ICICI Bank (2018) 1 SCC 407 — IBC overrides inconsistent state laws; financial creditor application admission criteria.
Para 11: Cite Swiss Ribbons Pvt Ltd v. Union of India (2019) 4 SCC 17 — constitutionality of IBC; FC vs OC distinction upheld.
Para 12: Cite Vidarbha Industries Power Ltd v. Axis Bank (2022) 8 SCC 352 — NCLT may exercise discretion at admission stage of S.7 application; not mechanical admission.
Para 13: Cite Pioneer Urban Land v. Union of India (2019) 8 SCC 416 — homebuyers as financial creditors; threshold of 100 or 10% allottees for class application (post-2020 amendment).
Para 14: Cite Macquarie Bank Ltd v. Shilpi Cable Technologies (2018) 2 SCC 674 — strict S.8 / S.9 procedural compliance for OC.
Para 15: Proposed IRP — name + IBBI registration. WRITTEN CONSENT in Form 2 mandatory. For S.10, applicant CD must propose IRP.
Para 16: Moratorium under S.14 — automatic on admission; effects:
(a) institution / continuation of suits / proceedings prohibited;
(b) transferring / encumbering assets prohibited;
(c) recovery of property in possession of CD prohibited;
(d) enforcement of security interest under SARFAESI prohibited.
Para 17: Effect of admission — public announcement, claims invitation, COC formation, resolution professional appointment.
Para 18: Statement of affairs / list of assets (especially for S.10 corporate applicant).
Para 19: Where personal guarantor under S.95 — different track; flag for advocate.
Para 20: Pre-pack insolvency under Ch. III-A (introduced 2021) — for MSMEs only; flag if applicable.
ATTACHMENTS — strictly per Form schedule:
- S.7 Form 1: Part I (financial creditor particulars), Part II (CD particulars), Part III (proposed IRP details), Part IV (financial debt particulars + documents), Part V (other information).
- S.9 Form 5: Part I-IV (similar) + Part V (invoice / demand notice / dispute particulars).
- S.10 Form 6: financial information, special resolution, audited financials.
Verification + affidavit per Form Part on solemn affirmation.
Append Lawie disclaimer.

relevantActs.act: Insolvency and Bankruptcy (Application to Adjudicating Authority) Rules, 2016

filing_checklist: Application in prescribed Form (1/5/6) + copies per NCLT Rules 2016 Rule 23
Information Utility (NeSL) records — preferred for default proof
Books of account / bank statements / ledger extracts
S.8 demand notice + proof of delivery (S.9 only)
Corporate Debtor MCA records (CIN proof, latest financials)
Filing fee — ₹25,000 (S.7 / S.9) / ₹25,000 (S.10) per NCLT Rules Schedule
Disclaimer slip — Lawie drafting assistance acknowledged
validation_rules: corporate_debtor_name and corporate_debtor_cin must not be empty
default_date must not be empty and not in future
If section_invoked = section_9_operational_creditor, s8_demand_notice_date must not be empty AND s8_demand_notice_delivery_proof must not be empty AND ≥10 days must have elapsed before filing
limitation_position must not be empty — flag if > 3 years from default without acknowledgment
advocate_enrollment must match Bar Council format
Court level restricted to NCLT only
key_citations: Innoventive Industries Ltd v. ICICI Bank (2018) 1 SCC 407 — IBC override + admission test
Mobilox Innovations Pvt Ltd v. Kirusa Software (2018) 1 SCC 353 — Pre-existing dispute test for S.9
Swiss Ribbons Pvt Ltd v. Union of India (2019) 4 SCC 17 — Constitutionality + FC/OC distinction
Pioneer Urban Land v. Union of India (2019) 8 SCC 416 — Homebuyers as FC
B.K. Educational Services v. Parag Gupta (2019) 11 SCC 633 — Limitation Art. 137
Asset Reconstruction Co v. Bishal Jaiswal (2021) 6 SCC 366 — Acknowledgment u/s.18 Limitation Act
Macquarie Bank Ltd v. Shilpi Cable Technologies (2018) 2 SCC 674 — Strict S.8 / S.9 compliance
Vidarbha Industries Power Ltd v. Axis Bank (2022) 8 SCC 352 — NCLT discretion in S.7 admission
Anuj Jain (IRP for Jaypee Infratech) v. Axis Bank (2020) 8 SCC 401 — Financial debt definition
